summary: Global Innovative Platforms Inc., a Delaware medical-instruments registrant, filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, reporting entry into a Services Agreement with Atlas Bookkeeping, LLC, owned by David R. Wells, who became Fractional CFO. Atlas provides bookkeeping, SEC reporting support, and CFO advisory services for an $8,000 monthly fee, terminable on 30 days' notice, governed by Delaware law. The filing also notes a change in principal financial and accounting officer designations related to Andrew Brow. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed; the event is a fractional CFO arrangement rather than a forced departure.
